events.title: Tupac Shakur: 30 Years On
events.blurb: Commemorating three decades since the tragic shooting of hip-hop icon Tupac Shakur in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Remembering Tupac
angles.copy: Thirty years ago today, the music world lost a legend. Tupac Shakur's influence continues to resonate.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix: A Legacy Remembered
events.blurb: Marking the anniversary of the passing of guitar virtuoso Jimi Hendrix.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Still inspiring guitarists worldwide, we remember the unparalleled talent of Jimi Hendrix today.

events.title: Abbey Road Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic album 'Abbey Road' was released 57 years ago today in 1969.

angles.name: Walk Across the Road
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. Which track is still on your playlist?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde, still rocking with The Pretenders.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Our Kid turns 54! Wishing a very happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis track?

events.title: 'Imagine' Turns 51
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released 51 years ago in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine 51 Years
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon's 'Imagine' gave us a song of peace and hope that still resonates today.

events.title: First iPod Launched 25 Years Ago
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the original iPod a quarter of a century ago, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember your first iPod? Today marks 25 years since Apple introduced the device that changed our music habits forever.

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: A day dedicated to celebrating the iconic British secret agent, James Bond.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Who's your favourite 007 and what's the best Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the enduring legacy of John Lennon.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the comedy genius, John Cleese. What's your favourite Python or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: 'The White Album' Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released 58 years ago in 1968.

angles.name: White Album 58 Years
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered the expansive 'White Album'. Which track from it stands out for you?

events.title: Freddie Mercury: 35 Years On
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, 35 years after his passing.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain legendary.

events.title: 'Rubber Soul' Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' influential album 'Rubber Soul' was released 61 years ago in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul 61 Years
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' shifted their sound. What's your favourite track from this classic?
